laws.rule: Hautes Fagnes nature reserve (eastern Wallonia, near Malmedy, Waimes, Baelen and Eupen): a Walloon Government order of 5 February 2026 (in force from 9 March 2026) sorts the public ways in the reserve into four categories, shown on a ministerial map. On first-category ways only pedestrians are allowed, plus dogs on a lead; cycling, riding and skiing are prohibited. On second-category ways pedestrians only, no dogs at all, and no movement from half an hour after sunset to half an hour before sunrise. On third-category ways (boardwalks) the boardwalk is for pedestrians only, while pedestrians, cyclists, riders and skiers may use the ground beside it, and dogs on a lead are allowed. Fourth-category ways follow the ordinary road and forest rules. The local forest officer can grant exemptions for specific needs. Check the reserve's signs and map before you walk.
laws.heading: Arrêté du Gouvernement wallon du 5 février 2026 relatif à la circulation sur les voies publiques dans la réserve naturelle des Hautes Fagnes, art. 2
